children: NXP Semiconductors reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $3.79B, up 19.3% year over year, while net income rose 40.1% to $884M and diluted EPS increased 40.3% to $3.48. Growth across several end markets and higher factory utilization contributed to the quarter’s results.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss) attributable to stockholders”. ³ Reported as “Net income (loss) per common share attributable to stockholders in $”.
Industrial & IoT revenue increased 38.5% year over year, while Communication Infrastructure & Other rose 53.8%. Automotive grew 12.7%, and Mobile declined 4.4%.
Q3 distributor revenue rose 20.3% year over year, compared with 18.0% growth in direct revenue.
Revenue increased across all regions, led by China at 28.8% growth and the Americas at 28.2%.
Higher sales volumes and factory utilization lifted gross margin to 57.8%. Management said revenue was slightly ahead of sequential expectations.
